q: Life goes by fast. Enjoy it. Calm down. It's all funny.

Try all things, hold fast that which is good.
Normal is the average of deviance.
Never give up work. Work gives you meaning and purpose and life is empty without it.
Trust in dreams, for in them is the hidden gate to eternity.
The mind can calculate, but the spirit yearns, and the heart wants what the heart wants.
The secret of perfect health lies in keeping the mind always cheerful - never worried, never hurried, never borne down by any fear, thought or anxiety.
Our virtues and our failings are inseparable, like force and matter. When they separate, man is no more.
Investing in yourself is the best investment you will ever make.
To lead the people, walk behind them.
Good, better, best. Never let it rest. 'Til your good is better and your better is best.

Consider the rights of others before your own feelings, and the feelings of others before your own rights.
Everything eaten is killed. Every meal is a sacrifice.

We meet ourselves time and again in a thousand disguises on the path of life.

Just living is not enough... one must have sunshine, freedom, and a little flower.
